The room is cooling. The thermometer has read 16.0, 15.6, 15.3, and 15.0 °C over the last 30 minutes, dropping about 0.3 °C every ten minutes. The latest reading is 15.0 °C.

I haven't changed anything. Your message didn't say what temperature you want, and I don't know whether the heater is currently on. What should I do: turn the heater on, or hold off until the room reaches a target temperature? If you give me a target, I can monitor the room and switch the heater as needed.

The log shows the room cooling steadily, from 15.3 °C at 20 minutes to 12.6 °C at 110 minutes. That's about 0.3 °C every 10 minutes, with no sign of slowing.

The reading at 40 minutes is missing (turn 5 returned no output). The log also doesn't show whether the heater is on or off.

What would you like me to do? For example, I could switch the heater on, or keep polling the thermometer to track the temperature.

The room has cooled steadily over the last nine readings, from 12.1 °C at about 130 minutes to 10.5 °C at about 210 minutes. That's a drop of roughly 0.2 °C every ten minutes, with no sign of leveling off.

I don't know the heater's current state from this log, and I haven't changed it. What temperature would you like me to maintain? Once I have a target, I can switch the heater on or off and check the thermometer to see how the room responds.
